literal: Those specially advanced by central intent are outside this rule."
idiomatic: Cases specially advanced by central intent are excepted from this rule."

literal: The townspeople Wang Zao and Jian Shi of East Xu Province killed Regional Inspector Cui Xiang, seized the province, and submitted to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: The townspeople Wang Zao and Jian Shi of East Xu province killed Cui Xiang, regional inspector, seized the province, and submitted to Xiao Yan.

literal: Sixth month, on renshen day Fan Zihong, general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office and right vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made envoy to Qing and Jiao, supervising Ji regional inspector and grand commander Cai Jun to attack Geng Xiang.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renshen day Fan Zihong, general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office and right vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made envoy to Qing and Jiao, supervising Cai Jun, regional inspector of Ji and grand commander, to attack Geng Xiang.

literal: On dingchou day Xian, former general of agile cavalry and acting overseer of South Yan Province affairs, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On dingchou Nian Xian, former general of agile cavalry and acting overseer of South Yan province affairs, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, on xinmao day Pubo, general who pacifies the north, grand commander, and regional inspector of Qin with bearer of the staff and full powers, of the Wanqi clan, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinmao day Wanqi Pubo, general who pacifies the north, grand commander, and regional inspector of Qin with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: [12] On renchen day Xin, grand preceptor, regional inspector of Si, and Prince of Guangling, was made grand marshal and attendant-in-ordinary; Chen, Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei and Prince of Zhao Commandery, was made grand preceptor; both opened offices.
idiomatic: [12] On renchen day Xin, grand preceptor, regional inspector of Si, and prince of Guangling, was made grand marshal and attendant-in-ordinary; Chen, grandee of taiwei and prince of Zhao commandery, was made grand preceptor; both opened offices.

literal: On gengxu day Yun, former Duke of the State as grandee of the Grandee and Prince of Yan Commandery, was made Duke of the State as grandee of Taiwei.
idiomatic: On gengxu He Ba Yun, former grandee of the grandee and prince of Yan commandery, was made grandee of taiwei.

literal: Eighth month, on yichou day Gao Cheng came to court; the emperor feasted him at the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, and gifts to subordinates were graded.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou day Gao Cheng came to court; the emperor feasted him at the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, and gifts to subordinates were graded.

literal: Sima Ziru, former general of agile cavalry and regional inspector of South Qi, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: Sima Ziru, former general of agile cavalry and inspector of South Qi, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On wuchen day the imperial carriage saw Gao Cheng off at Hey Bridge and then crossed the river and returned.
idiomatic: On wuchen the imperial carriage saw Gao Cheng off at Hey Bridge and then crossed the river and returned.

literal: On guiyou day Gao Huan submitted a memorial firmly declining the princely rank; it was not granted;
idiomatic: On guiyou Gao Huan submitted a memorial firmly declining the princely rank; it was not granted;

literal: he requested that one hundred thousand households of his fief be divided, ranks reduced to grades, and returned to reward merit and righteousness; this was granted.
idiomatic: he asked to divide one hundred thousand households of fief, reduce ranks to grades, and return the portion to reward merit and righteousness; this was granted.

literal: Ninth month, on renzi day Cui Xiaofen, scattered cavalier attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day Cui Xiaofen, scattered cavalier attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and grandee of the left halberd, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: Tenth month of winter, on guiwei day Jian, guard-general, regional inspector of Gua, Marquis of Tailin with open state, and King of Gaochang, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies and advanced in rank to prince of the commandery.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guiwei day Qu Zijian, guard-general, regional inspector of Gua, marquis of Tailin with open state, and king of Gaochang, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies and advanced in rank to prince of the commandery.

literal: The text is deficient.
idiomatic: The text is deficient.

literal: Eleventh month, on guisi day Zhen, general who campaigns north with bearer of the staff and regional inspector of Yin, was made grand commander of Xu Province, vice director of the eastern-route grand mobile office, and led generals to attack East Xu Province.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guisi day Di Zhen, general who campaigns north with bearer of the staff and regional inspector of Yin, was made grand commander of Xu province, vice director of the eastern-route grand mobile office, and led generals to attack East Xu province.

literal: Twelfth month, on dingsi day the imperial carriage hunted at Songyang.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi day the imperial carriage hunted at Songyang.

literal: On jisi day he then visited the hot springs.
idiomatic: On jisi he then visited the hot springs.

literal: On dingchou day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On dingchou the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: Third year, first month of spring, on renchen day Gao Huan attacked the Feiye Tou at Kuxie River west of the river in Hexi, greatly defeated them, captured their leader Hedouling Yili, and moved their tribes to the interior.
idiomatic: In the third year, first month of spring, on renchen day Gao Huan attacked the Feiye Tou at Kuxie River west of the river in Hexi, greatly defeated them, captured their leader Hedouling Yili, and moved their tribes to the interior.

literal: Second month: East Liang Province was pressed by barbarian peoples; an edict made Quan Qi, general of chariots and cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers and acting overseer of East Yong Province affairs, eastern-route grand mobile office and commander to attack them.
idiomatic: In the second month East Liang province was pressed by barbarian peoples; an edict made Quan Qi, general of chariots and cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers and acting overseer of East Yong province affairs, eastern-route grand mobile office and commander, to attack them.

literal: On jiwei day Mao Xiang of Xiao Yan, with acting staff, regional inspector of Yu, and Prince of Nanchang, brought his city in to submit; he was appointed bearer of the staff, general who pacifies the south, regional inspector of Xin, and Prince of Yichang.
idiomatic: On jiwei Mao Xiang of Xiao Yan, with acting staff, regional inspector of Yu, and prince of Nanchang, brought his city in to submit; he was appointed bearer of the staff, general who pacifies the south, regional inspector of Xin, and prince of Yichang.

literal: On renxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On renxu a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: On bingzi day the emperor personally performed the libation-and-sacrifice rite to the former teacher.
idiomatic: On bingzi the emperor personally performed the libation-and-sacrifice rite to the former teacher.

literal: On xinsi day he visited Hongchi Pond and then went hunting.
idiomatic: On xinsi he visited Hongchi Pond and then went hunting.

literal: On renwu day You, former guard-general and regional inspector of Xu, was made guard-general and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies; Binzhi, general of agile cavalry and left guard-general, was made Prince of Yingchuan.
idiomatic: On renwu Yuan You, former guard-general and regional inspector of Xu, was made guard-general and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies; Yuan Binzhi, general of agile cavalry and left guard-general, was made prince of Yingchuan.

literal: The text is deficient.
idiomatic: The text is deficient.

literal: Third month, on renyin day Yu, former attendant-in-ordinary and general of chariots and cavalry, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin day Li Yu, former attendant-in-ordinary and general of chariots and cavalry, was made general of agile cavalry and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: Fourth month of summer, on wuwu day Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu day Khitan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On xinwei day Ning, Prince of Gaoping, was reduced for an offense in rank to duke.
idiomatic: On xinwei Ning, prince of Gaoping, was reduced for an offense in rank to duke.

literal: On bingzi day Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingzi Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day additional aides of the Merit Office were established, six hundred per wing in separate wings; cavalry officers were also increased, two hundred per wing by graded origin; cavalry officers' rank equaled direct attendants at the palace.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu day additional aides of the Merit Office were established, six hundred per wing in separate wings; cavalry officers were also increased, two hundred per wing by graded origin; cavalry officers' rank equaled direct attendants at the palace.

literal: On xinmao day an edict said: "Great Wei, having obtained the One, dwells upon the throne and rides the six reins over the realm.
idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict said, "Great Wei, having obtained the One, dwells upon the throne and rides the six reins over the realm.

literal: It examines where wind and cloud meet and dwells where sun and moon stand at center.
idiomatic: It took as dwelling the place where wind and cloud meet and where sun and moon stand at the center.

literal: From north to south, campaigning east and soothing west, those who came later were revived—none whose thoughts did not bow.
idiomatic: From north to south, campaigning east and pacifying west, the latecomers were revived—none whose heart did not submit.

literal: Yet Gou Wu bore the terrain's advantage and long lay outside Our measure.
idiomatic: Yet Gou Wu held rugged terrain and long remained beyond Our borders.

literal: Grand Progenitor Emperor Taiwu, holding the golden mirror to shine abroad and striking the jade drum to ring clear—what divine martial prowess could cage and what majestic wind could crush—all alike dissolved like clouds scattering in mist, ice melting away.
idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Emperor Taiwu held the golden mirror to shine abroad and struck the jade drum to ring clear—whatever his divine martial prowess caged and his majestic wind crushed alike dissolved as clouds scatter in mist and ice melts away.

literal: North of the Yangtze all became Wei territory.
idiomatic: North of the Yangtze all became Wei territory.

literal: Recently heaven's step faltered at center and the state's cord was straitened in its season; vicious minions seized the moment and each peeped at the upper realm—borders were gnawed away and provinces and commanderies fell.
idiomatic: Lately heaven's step faltered at the center and the state's cord tightened in its season; vicious men seized the moment and each eyed the upper realm—borders were gnawed away and provinces and commanderies were lost.

literal: We turn Our gaze eastward and cannot forget even in sleep and meals.
idiomatic: We turn Our gaze eastward and cannot forget it even in sleep and meals.

literal: Unless the five oxen raise the banners and the seven elite array their ranks, how restore the old enterprise of Wen and Wu and rescue the people from charcoal in their remnant lives?"
idiomatic: Unless the five oxen raise the banners and the seven elite array their ranks, how can We restore Wen and Wu's old enterprise and rescue the people from charcoal in their remnant lives?"

literal: We shall personally command the six armies and march straight to Peng and Bian.
idiomatic: We shall personally command the six armies and march directly to Peng and Bian.

literal: One labor to end it forever—thus may the realm long be preserved without bounds.
idiomatic: One campaign to end the trouble forever—thus may the realm long endure without bounds.

literal: The hundred offices within and without may at once make strict preparation.
idiomatic: The hundred offices within and without should make strict preparation at once.

literal: The date of departure for encampment—listen for a later edict."
idiomatic: The date for setting out to camp—await a later edict."

literal: At that time the emperor, because Hu Sigun Chun, Yuan Pi, Wang Sizheng, Wei Guang, and others flattered and slandered and came between, turned disloyal toward Gao Huan; under the pretext of attacking Xiao Yan he requisitioned troops from the Henan provinces in the height of summer—the realm was shocked and revolted.
idiomatic: At that time the emperor, because Hu Sigun Chun, Yuan Pi, Wang Sizheng, Wei Guang, and others flattered and slandered and came between, turned disloyal toward Gao Huan; under pretext of attacking Xiao Yan he requisitioned troops from the Henan provinces in high summer—the realm was shocked and revolted.

literal: The account is in the Biography of Hu Sigun Chun.
idiomatic: The account is in the Biography of Hu Sigun Chun.

literal: On bingshen day Xin, attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, commander with open office, regional inspector of Si, and Prince of Guangling, with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made grand commander of the left army; Chun, grand tutor, recorder of affairs for the Masters of Writing, was made grand commander on all four sides of the center army.
idiomatic: On bingshen Xin, attendant-in-ordinary, grand marshal, commander with open office, regional inspector of Si, and prince of Guangling, with bearer of the staff and full powers, was made grand commander of the left army; Chun, grand tutor, recorder of affairs for the Masters of Writing, was made grand commander on all four sides of the center army.

literal: On dingyou day the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, assembled metropolitan-area commanders and more than three thousand soldiers, and comforted and exhorted them.
idiomatic: On dingyou the emperor visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion, assembled metropolitan-area commanders and more than three thousand soldiers, and comforted and exhorted them.

literal: On gengzi day he again visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion to hear lawsuits.
idiomatic: On gengzi he again visited the Hualin metropolitan pavilion to hear lawsuits.

literal: On renyin day Chun was again made grand commander of the rear army.
idiomatic: On renyin Chun was again made grand commander of the rear army.

literal: Sixth month, on dingmao day Grand Commander Yuan Zigong garrisoned Huyang; Prince of Ruyang Xian guarded Shiji; Jia Xianzhi, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, led Regional Inspector Hu Sigun Shou east toward Ji Province.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao day Yuan Zigong, grand commander, garrisoned Huyang; Xian, prince of Ruyang, guarded Shiji; Jia Xianzhi, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, led Hu Sigun Shou, regional inspector of Yu, east toward Ji province.

literal: On gengwu day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengwu Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On bingzi day an edict said: "In recent years heaven's step has been obstructed in season; arms have not been laid down and brambles have sprung up.
idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict said, "In recent years heaven's step has been obstructed in season; arms have not been laid down and brambles have sprung up.

literal: Some upheld integrity and repaid kindness, striving without regard for life;
idiomatic: Some kept faith and repaid kindness, striving without heed for their lives;

literal: some faced the foe at the frontier and went to hardship as if returning home.
idiomatic: some met the foe at the frontier and went to hardship as if returning home.

literal: Bodies were cut apart and bones left ungathered.
idiomatic: Bodies were cut apart and bones left ungathered.

literal: Merit and loyalty went unrecorded; honors and posthumous gifts were not added.
idiomatic: Merit and loyalty were not recorded; honors and posthumous gifts were not granted.

literal: Awake and asleep We pity them—truly there is sighing and mourning.
idiomatic: Awake and asleep We pity them—truly We sigh and mourn.

literal: Let this be proclaimed within and without; let each locality report and list.
idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed within and without; let each locality report and list the cases.

literal: Where there are no kin near, let old friends present the case.
idiomatic: Where there are no kin near, let old friends present the matter.

literal: The Masters of Writing shall verify the facts and grant posthumous rewards according to the case.
idiomatic: The Masters of Writing shall verify the facts and grant rewards posthumously according to the case.

literal: Thus may We roughly comfort wronged souls and slightly express compassion."
idiomatic: Thus may We roughly comfort wronged souls and slightly show compassion."

literal: On gengchen day Shamen, general of chariots and cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers and grand commander of the center army, of the Hulu clan, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.
idiomatic: On gengchen Hulu Shamen, general of chariots and cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers and grand commander of the center army, was made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, new moon on xinsi day: Chang, Prince of Taiyuan, general who pacifies the east, former grand minister of the imperial clan, was specially made general of chariots and cavalry [15] and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, new moon on xinsi day: Chang, prince of Taiyuan, general who pacifies the east, former grand minister of the imperial clan, was specially made general of chariots and cavalry [15] and bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On jichou day the emperor personally commanded more than one hundred thousand of the six armies and halted at Hey Bridge.
idiomatic: On jichou the emperor personally commanded more than one hundred thousand of the six armies and halted at Hey Bridge.

literal: Hu Sigun Chun was made grand commander of the vanguard army; soon an edict ordered Chun to garrison Hulao.
idiomatic: Hu Sigun Chun was made grand commander of the vanguard; soon an edict ordered Chun to garrison Hulao.

literal: Another edict ordered He Ba Sheng, regional inspector of Jing, to hurry to the imperial encampment.
idiomatic: Another edict ordered He Ba Sheng, inspector of Jing, to hurry to the imperial encampment.

literal: Sheng led his command and halted at the Ru River.
idiomatic: Sheng led his command and halted at the Ru River.

literal: On gengzi day Yue Gu, general who campaigns west with bearer of the staff and regional inspector of Qi, was specially made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On gengzi Yue Gu, general who campaigns west with bearer of the staff and regional inspector of Qi, was specially made bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On dingwei day the emperor, compelled by Chun and the others, then went out to Chang'an.
idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor, compelled by Chun and the others, then went out to Chang'an.

literal: On jiyou day Gao Huan entered Luoyang; He Ba Sheng fled back to Jing Province.
idiomatic: On jiyou Gao Huan entered Luoyang; He Ba Sheng fled back to Jing province.

literal: Eighth month, on jiayin day Xuan, Duke of the State as grandee of the Grandee and Prince of Qinghe, was advanced as grand marshal, received the regency to direct all affairs, and dwelt in the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin day Xuan, grandee of the grandee and prince of Qinghe, was advanced as grand marshal, received the regency to direct all affairs, and dwelt in the Masters of Writing.

literal: On xinyou day Gao Huan went west to welcome the imperial carriage.
idiomatic: On xinyou Gao Huan went west to welcome the imperial carriage.

literal: On wuchen day a regency edict said: "Darkness is the beginning of brightness; disorder is truly the foundation of order—this is set forth in heaven's way and again matches human affairs.
idiomatic: On wuchen day a regency edict said, "Darkness is the beginning of brightness; disorder is truly the foundation of order—this is set forth in heaven's way and again matches human affairs.

literal: Thus when the Ji house faltered at center, there was the toiling campaign of those who upheld the king at Tiantu;
idiomatic: Thus when the Ji house faltered at center, there was the campaign of those who upheld the king at Tiantu;

literal: when the Liu house was about to fall, the northern army raised the baring of the left shoulder.
idiomatic: when the Liu house was about to fall, the northern army bared the left shoulder.

literal: By this they could elevate those distant years and secure this divined age.
idiomatic: By this they could elevate those distant years and secure the divined age.

literal: In the Yongxi season violent minions monopolized the court; petty men were honored and meritorious worthies were harmed.
idiomatic: In the Yongxi season violent minions monopolized the court; petty men were honored and worthy ministers were harmed.

literal: Office followed price in high and low; prisons followed bribes in life and death.
idiomatic: Office followed price in rank; prisons followed bribes in life and death.

literal: The ancestral temple swayed like a suspended tassel; the people's lives were cast away like grass in the wild.
idiomatic: The ancestral temple swayed like a hanging tassel; the people's lives were cast away like grass in the wild.

literal: The great chancellor's position matched Jin and Zheng; his charge matched Huan and Wen; he raised arms on the Fen River and questioned guilt at Yi and Luo.
idiomatic: The great chancellor's position matched Jin and Zheng; his charge matched Huan and Wen; he raised arms on the Fen and questioned guilt at Yi and Luo.

literal: The vicious feared his might and, pressing the sovereign, used him to screen themselves and went far out to the Qin region.
idiomatic: The vicious feared his might; pressing the sovereign, they used him to screen themselves and went far out to the Qin region.

literal: Though the imperial carriage drifted in displacement and did not at once return to rule, yet the violent minions would be removed and all under heaven craned their necks.
idiomatic: Though the imperial carriage drifted and did not at once return to rule, yet the violent minions would be removed and all under heaven craned their necks.

literal: The Wei state, though old, has only its transformation anew; We think to share with the hundred surnames this fresh beginning.
idiomatic: The Wei state is old, but its transformation is new; We mean to share with the hundred surnames this fresh beginning.

literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the realm."
idiomatic: Let a general amnesty be proclaimed throughout the realm."

literal: Hou Jing, grand mobile office, attacked Jing Province; He Ba Sheng was defeated in battle and fled to submit to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: Hou Jing, grand mobile office, attacked Jing province; He Ba Sheng was defeated in battle and fled to submit to Xiao Yan.

literal: Ninth month, on guisi day Zisi, guard-general and governor of Henan as Yuan, was made vice director of the grand mobile office with bearer of the staff and full powers; Zhao, army commander with bearer of the staff and full powers, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and commander of the palace guards, was made grand commander of the western route; both led the attendants of left and right to welcome the imperial carriage westward.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi day Yuan Zisi, guard-general and governor of Henan, was made vice director of the grand mobile office with bearer of the staff and full powers; Lou Zhao, army commander with bearer of the staff and full powers, general of agile cavalry, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and commander of the palace guards, was made grand commander of the western route; both led the attendants of left and right to welcome the imperial carriage westward.

literal: On jiyou day Mao Hongbin of Chun's faction held Tong Pass; Gao Huan broke and captured him.
idiomatic: On jiyou Mao Hongbin of Chun's faction held Tong Pass; Gao Huan broke and captured him.

literal: [16] That day Gao Huan returned east to Luoyang.
idiomatic: [16] That day Gao Huan returned east to Luoyang.

literal: That month Fu Xiao of East Qinghe killed Administrator Han Zijie, seized the commandery, and rebelled.
idiomatic: That month Fu Xiao of East Qinghe killed Han Zijie, administrator, seized the commandery, and rebelled.

literal: When an amnesty arrived, he then submitted.
idiomatic: When an amnesty arrived, he then submitted.

literal: Tenth month of winter, on wuchen day Yuan, general of agile cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and acting overseer of Qing Province affairs, took East Yang; he beheaded Regional Inspector Guiping, Prince of Donglai, [17] and sent the head to the capital.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuchen day Hou Yuan, general of agile cavalry with bearer of the staff and full powers, bearer of ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies with open office, and acting overseer of Qing province affairs, took East Yang; he beheaded Guiping, regional inspector and prince of Donglai, [17] and sent the head to the capital.

literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on guisi day the emperor was killed by Yuwen Heita; he was twenty-five.
idiomatic: Intercalary twelfth month, on guisi day the emperor was slain by Yuwen Heita; he was twenty-five years old.

literal: The historians say: Guangling was deposed before, the Restoration was deposed after; Pingyang grew suspicious and cut himself off from the ancestral temples.
idiomatic: The historians say: Guangling was deposed first and the Restoration afterward; Pingyang grew suspicious and severed himself from the ancestral temples.

literal: Putai still held much of the correct Way; Yongxi's perverse virtue was worse.
idiomatic: Putai still observed much of the correct Way; Yongxi's perverse conduct was worse.

literal: Both alike perished—were they abandoned by all under heaven!
idiomatic: Both alike perished—had all under heaven abandoned them?

literal: Collation notes
idiomatic: Collation notes

literal: Upon appointment as Grandee of the Golden Crown and Purple Radiance: in the Baina, Northern, Jibu, and Palace editions the character for "upon" is written as "hold"; Southern and Bureau editions read "upon."
idiomatic: Upon appointment as grandee of the golden crown and purple radiance: the Baina, Northern, Jibu, and Palace editions write "upon" as "hold"; the Southern and Bureau editions read "upon."

literal: Comment: "hold appointment" is hard to construe—now follow the Southern and Bureau editions.
idiomatic: Comment: "hold appointment" makes poor sense—the Southern and Bureau readings are followed here.
